propositions: FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action (plans adding mechanisms without establishing need), but plan-review gate has no criterion to detect necessity gaps
bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified: bug 5886 persisted with runner=exempt, llm_calls=0)
necessity probe must be a single-turn advisory criterion that flags plans lacking reproduction or motivation, distinct from asserted-capability which checks for existing implementations
bug review tier must run DET floor + necessity probe as advisory only (never blocking), replacing the current full exemption
necessity criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json with default_posture=advisory and no suppress_types=["bug"] entry to apply to bugs
advisory->blocking promotion decision is operator-attested dogfood-gated on standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder metrics (d8a5), not unilateral config flag
